upload.title: Upload a PDF to get started
upload.description: Choose a .pdf file (opens directly in workspace)

viewLayers.title: View layers
viewLayers.annotationHint: Built-in PDF highlights and comments — rendered by PDF.js
viewLayers.ocrLayerHint: OCR text on scanned PDFs — turn off if misaligned

aiPanel.indexError: Could not prepare document for chat.

aiPanel.chatReadonlyPlaceholder: Run Summary first to ask about this document…
aiPanel.chatReady: Chat is ready — type your question.
aiPanel.summaryMissingDocumentId: Summary finished but the server did not return document_id — chat is unavailable.

aiPanel.chatNoContextHint: Tap “Generate summary” again on the Summary tab, wait until it finishes, then ask your question.
aiPanel.noDocumentId: Document is not indexed yet. Wait or run Summary first.

answerLanguage.label: Answer language
answerLanguage.hint: Summary and chat replies will be in this language.

aiPanel.summaryPlaceholder: Run summary to see AI-generated highlights for this PDF.
aiPanel.summaryDone: Summary is ready. Open the Summary tab to read it.
aiPanel.title: AI Assistant

voice.subtitle: Listen to your document with built-in browser speech
voice.noVoicesHint: No voice for this language in your browser. On macOS: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice.
voice.prepareHint: Process the PDF once first (same as enabling chat) — about 1–2 minutes.
voice.unsupported: Speech synthesis is not supported in this browser.

aiPanel.welcome: This appears to be a 3-page document. I can summarize, translate, OCR, or extract tables.
aiPanel.reply: Got it. I am analyzing this page and preparing a concise answer with key points.

aiToolPage.prepareHint: Processing takes about 1–2 minutes. Keep this tab open.

aiSummaryPage.uploadSubtitle: AI reads, analyzes, and creates a structured summary
aiSummaryPage.uploadDropHint: Drag & drop or choose a file
aiSummaryPage.downloadFailed: Could not download the summary file.
aiSummaryPage.restoredFileHint: Summary saved for «{name}». Re-select the file to preview the PDF.

aiChatPage.restoredFileHint: Chat restored for «{name}». Re-select the file to preview the PDF.

aiVoicePage.documentReady: Ready to read aloud — press play.
aiVoicePage.restoredFileHint: Reading session restored for «{name}». Re-select the file to preview the PDF.
aiVoicePage.readContentHint: Press play to listen to the document.

split.pickFileHint: Choose a part to continue editing, or download all as ZIP.
